invariant: every benchmark prompt has split='test' AND isHoldout=true; the SFT/DPO dataset builder hard-excludes any prompt with isHoldout=true
rationale: First held-out benchmark for the 'did our data produce a better Igala model' experiment. Gold (483 ColdAuthorAnswer rows, isDemo=false) is concentrated: only orthography (39), grammar_tone (39) and lexicon_disambig (25) have multi-prompt gold pools; dialectal_fidelity, register_honorifics, idioms_metaphor, cultural_values and authenticity have a single gold prompt each. register/idioms/cultural were already the 3 pre-existing test prompts. We therefore freeze a stratified 40 new prompts weighted to the three data-rich buckets (15/15/8) plus the two remaining single-gold buckets (dialectal ig_dial_001, authenticity ig_auth_001) to give the benchmark coverage of all 8 buckets. Every frozen prompt has >=1 gold answer (so exclusion is meaningful) and >=1 stored baseline ModelOutput (so blind tuned-vs-baseline pairs and Rung-A baseline metrics are available). The three high-gold 'mega seed' prompts (ig_orth_001, ig_gram_001, ig_lex_001) are deliberately KEPT in training so their rich multi-annotator gold trains the model rather than sitting idle in the benchmark.
selectionMethod: Deterministic: within ig_bank_orth_* / ig_bank_gram_* / ig_bank_lex_*, take the first 15/15/8 distinct gold promptIds sorted ascending; plus ig_dial_001 and ig_auth_001 (their buckets' only gold prompt).
